technology_name: Cane Jam Production from Sugarcane Juice
institution: ICAR-Sugarcane Breeding Institute Research Centre, Kannur
problem_solved: Limited value-added products from sugarcane juice
description: This technology utilizes sugarcane juice for the preparation of jam products, creating an additional avenue for value addition in sugarcane processing. The product converts fresh sugarcane juice into a shelf-stable food item suitable for direct consumption and food applications.
applications:
Fruit spread, jam, and preserve manufacturing companies
Sugarcane processing and value-addition enterprises
Food processing MSMEs and agro-processing units
Retail food brands and packaged food manufacturers
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and agri-food startups developing sugarcane-based products
secondary_sector: Consumer & Lifestyle Products, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
